race.comment: TRULY GALLANT (4) gets the chance to rebound after finishing fifth to VIVAROK in CL2 company at this track, where he raced wide throughout as a well-supported favourite. His nose second in CL2 grade the start prior reads strongly for this, and his record at this track and distance keeps him at the top of the list. FORBIDDEN APPLE (5) is the immediate danger after winning well from Shoot To Fame two back and then running Giles to just under a length as favourite. CANTILEVER (3) has placed at each run this campaign and owns a strong track-and-distance record, although he has had recent chances against some of these. MYSTERY BULLET (11) brings two country seconds, including a narrow Leinster defeat, and his 3kg claim plus previous win at this track and distance make him a genuine winning threat if that form transfers to the stronger meeting. KEYTRADE (6) won't be far away.
